answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that emits a fresh signed signal every epoch; standing accretes glacier-slow only as already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet pools every endorsement in one lagoon tracing to a single root, never gathering distinct cross-cluster signals, so its standing stays frozen. Honest pays one anchor once; a farm funds a distinct anchor plus a slow climb per head, cost linear per head.
